## @interlace/docs-page-template

Installed to `components/ui/templates/docs-page-template.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/templates/docs-page-template';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/docs-page-template

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
